name: French
notes: Five courses beyond first-year French: the four core courses plus one elective.
Students who place directly into FREN 200 take TWO electives instead of one, since the minor is still five courses.
All courses you intend to count toward the minor must be approved by the undergraduate advisor before you declare the minor.

requirementGroups.label: Core French courses
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: The minor in French requires five courses beyond first-year French. These will include the core courses: FREN 153: Intermediate French; FREN 200: Advanced French; FREN 202: Introduction to French Literature; FREN 204: Contemporary France

requirementGroups.label: One French elective
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: And one elective (or two electives, if the student places directly into FREN 200), which could include one or more pf the following: FREN 155: French Conversation; FREN 157 or 207: French in France; Another 200-level course in French in consultation with the undergraduate advisor
